name: aipathshala-mobile
description: Capacitor shell wrapping the AI Pathshala PWA for iOS + Android.

scripts.ios:archive: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App archive
scripts.publish:android: cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && echo 'Upload android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab to Play Console'
scripts.publish:ios: echo 'Run: npx cap open ios → Xcode → Product → Archive → Distribute App → App Store Connect'
